name: Adventure Impossible
description: Three of Strahd's most powerful allies lurk in hidden Lairs. You must find and defeat three of them, one hero at a time.

objectives.description: Defeat 3 of Strahd's villains found in hidden Lairs

specialRules.description: Three random Lair tiles are hidden in the dungeon. When a Lair is revealed, spawn its paired Villain instead of drawing a Monster. The Villain activates each Villain Phase.
There are no Healing Surge tokens. When a Hero is reduced to 0 HP, complete the current Villain Phase, then the next Hero begins on the Start tile.
When the active Hero dies, the next Hero in the roster takes over from the Start tile. Defeat is only triggered when the last Hero dies with fewer than 3 villains defeated.

introText: The castle is vast and your allies are scattered. You must assault Strahd's stronghold one hero at a time, hunting down three of his most dangerous champions.
victoryText: Three of Strahd's greatest champions lie defeated. The castle trembles — the vampire lord's power is broken!
defeatText: The last hero falls. Strahd's champions remain undefeated, and Barovia is lost.
